text:
sara: FYI deploy v2.14 started rolling at 1934567888, canary to 10%
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate for service 'accounts-write' (5xx spike) detected at 1934567920
mike: seeing a bunch of SQL errors in canary logs: "ERROR: column "user_prefs" does not exist" on writes to accounts table
anish: ugh — that sounds like migration ordering. did the schema migration land after the service that writes the new column?
sara: deploy manifest did schema-migration job then app, but logs show migration hung for a while then timed out and the app finished deploy on canary nodes without the column present
oncall-db: I’m paged and looking into the migration job trace. attaching log snippet:
```
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN user_prefs JSONB;
-- waiting for lock until 1934567905
ERROR: canceling statement due to statement timeout
```
elaine: canary showing approx 30% of requests failing for users hitting write path, frontends degrade fallback but some signups fail. CS reported 4 customers complaining about creation errors
ops-lead: we should stop the rollout, kill flag / rollback. @deploy-bot can you pause the rollout and put a kill-switch on the feature flag?
deploy-bot: pausing rollout for v2.14 across all regions. Initiating feature-flag kill: feature.new-account-prefs -> off.
incident-bot: On-call handoff: @oncall-db now lead for DB mitigation, @sara leads deploy coordination.
oncall-db: root cause: ALTER TABLE attempting a full-table rewrite, blocked by long-running replica catch-up and a background job (legacy-backfill). Migration timed out so partial state: app code expects column but schema not present on primary. Need quick mitigation: either resume migration with lock management or revert app to older code that doesn't reference column.
mike: rollback app to v2.13? That will restore compatibility immediately. How long to rollback?
sara: rollback queued. Rolling back canaries first. Rolling back main deploy now via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rollback to v2.13 initiated at 1934567995. Canary nodes rolling back.
oncall-db: while rollback proceeds, I'll try to retry migration in controlled mode: online ADD COLUMN with default NULL (fast) then backfill async. Proposed SQL: `ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_prefs JSONB DEFAULT '{}'` — that avoids rewrite on some DBs but needs care.
ops-lead: confirm with PG specialists before adding default. If DB is Postgres, adding column with non-null default causes table rewrite on older versions. Need to run `ADD COLUMN ... NULL` then `UPDATE ...` in batches.
anish: agree, don't do full rewrite. Can we add a nullable column without default? That should be fast without rewrite.
oncall-db: I'll run `ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_prefs JSONB` with lock_timeout=5s and statement_timeout=30s, monitor locks. If it keeps failing, we'll revert plan and do application rollback only.
customer-success: flagging impacted customers and drafting message: approx 4 customers with create errors, potential data-loss risk? need confirmation.
mike: rollback to v2.13 completed on canary and main at 1934568050. Error rate for accounts-write dropping. Monitoring now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation in progress — rollback applied, DB oncall running safe migration attempt.
oncall-db: first attempt still shows lock contention with legacy-backfill pid 4213. Killing that backfill job now (in coordination with infra team).
els: killing background job — killed pid 4213, replication lag now 2s.
oncall-db: retrying ALTER TABLE with lock_timeout=5s. Success acquiring lock on replica, but primary required promotion. Running migration on primary at 1934568150.
ops-lead: good. once column is added, we can redeploy v2.14 safely. But let's keep feature flag off until we verify backfill.
sara: agreed. keep feature.new-account-prefs OFF, redeploy blocked until DB confirm.
customer-success: sent interim note to impacted customers: apology + status update. asking to escalate if still seeing errors.
mike: monitoring logs — write errors dropped to baseline after rollback, no new errors reported.
oncall-db: column added successfully on primary at 1934568187. Now scheduling backfill in small batches to populate historical JSON; it will be async and monitored.
incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handover planned at 1934569000 to next shift. Current leads: oncall-db, sara.
ops-lead: summary for execs: deploy v2.14 started canary -> schema migration job timed out -> application code rolled out without schema -> writes failed on canary -> rollback applied -> DB ops added column with safe procedure -> backfill in progress -> feature flag remains off -> plan to reattempt controlled rollout after backfill verification.
sara: postmortem owners: @mike (deploy flow), @oncall-db (migration runbook), @anish (feature-flag safety). Please start timeline notes.
customer-success: follow-up ticket created for impacted customers, CS lead assigned.
oncall-db: will monitor backfill, expect no customer-visible issues. will update thread if lock or replication problems reappear.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): rollback succeeded and DB schema stabilized. Will remain open for postmortem and backfill completion.
sara: thanks everyone. major action items: create migration checklist, add deploy pre-checks for migration completion, add automatic rollback if migration fails.
mike: filing postmortem draft now, tagging priority P1.
elaine: adding incident to oncall review board.
ops-lead: good job coordinating. closing active page, will keep this thread for PM/pmc notes.
incident-bot: thread archived for search index at 1934569123
